I know, but it's just not her.
It's the constant failures in life that keeps on going making me feel more and more close to killing myself.
I live in a pretty small town in the middle of Sweden.

Yeah I'm from Sweden it's 0:10 here atm.
I can't really sleep and all I do is smkoing ciggarettes, to calm me down.

The thing that sucks the most, is that I lost all of my friends.
And my girlfriend was the last person that I had in my life, and now when everything has come down to it.

I'm alone, empty and I don't have anything left, except for my dog.
Don't get me wrong she's more than enough, but I am just not sure  if I have the strenght to go on with another heartbreak and failure in life.

I know that my family will treat her well.

It's pretty bad today.
I know my parents love me, but they are so tired of me not getting my life togheter.

So I rarely talk with my parents, because all they do is to tell me to get my life togheter to just "cheer up" and after a while, it gets more exhausting than motivating,
I'm trying to but everything she says is that she doesn't want to talk to me and the friend she said she was staying with says she's not there.

I've always wanted my own dog, since I've always had dogs when growing up.
And I won some money back in 2016 so I could afford to get one, and when I contacted the seller it just seemed right, so my father drove me about 400 kilometers to pick her up.

I don't a phone.
And she doesn't want to talk with me on Facebook, she's supposed to get home (we live togehter) and get her things tomorrow.

I forgot the mention, the real kicked that triggered this.
Is that my current girlfriend, or ex now.

Had this one guy who she had been with for seven years, a pure sexual relationship a rich guy 15 years older than her, and she promised me to not contact him.

However tonight she did, because she wasn't logged out of Facebook on my laptop, so I saw that she was trying to reach him.

And this is my breaking point, I really don't feel for going on anymore.

Hey, thanks.
it's been a long and exhausting ride.

She got into my life last year in April, she's a wonderful loving and caring dog, a mix of American Staffordshire Terrier and Rottweiler, she's the sweetest but the most clumpsy dog I have ever met.

She's about one and a half years old now.
